name: MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Super-MagLev + Frosted)
description: Discover a new era of speedcubing performance with the MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Super-MagLev + Frosted). This innovative 3x3 features a cutting-edge MagLev-tension system, which replaces traditional springs with opposing magnets for faster, smoother, and quieter turns.
